column1: # mapping_set_title: NIST AI RMF GAI Profile (AI 600-1) - SSSOM mapping set
#   Mappings between NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile schema
#   elements and related concepts in the lmodel ecosystem (ISO 27001,
#   ISO 29100, OSCAL profile, NIST CSF v2, STIX, SLSA, SPDX, GIST core).

column7: GaiProfile is a cross-sectoral profile - OSCAL Profile is the analogous mechanism.
Both serialise a framework profile document.
GaiRisk is GAI-specific; iso27001:Risk is the broader risk concept.
A GaiRisk may be a privacy risk; related but narrower.
GaiRisk inherits from AiSpecificRisk - both are "AI-only" risks; close (subclass relation).
STIX Course of Action is the analogous "recommended action" concept.
Both express something an organisation can do to manage risk.
gist:Task is a planned/scheduled activity; related.
Property-like consideration attached to the framework.
Engaging interested parties / public for feedback.
Red-teaming explores adversarial attack patterns against AI systems.
OSCAL profiles include controls by reference - analogous linking semantics.
